description.value: Beaucoup Bakery & Café is an award-winning French patisserie founded in 2012, now operating its flagship downtown location inside the historic St. Regis Hotel on Dunsmuir Street. Co-owned by Betty and Jacky Hung, it blends classic French viennoiserie techniques with Asian-inspired ingredients, producing signature items like the Peking Duck Croissant, Yuzu Almond Financier, and Golden Mochi Croissant alongside espresso drinks and savoury seasonal sandwiches. It has been recognized by Lonely Planet, Forbes Travel Guide, and USA Today as one of Vancouver's top culinary destinations.
